subtitle: About this page — not the CV.

sections.title: First section
body: Write here. This text lives in data/about.json, under sections[0].body — each string in that list becomes one paragraph.
This page is the odd one out in the repo: everything else is generated from cv/cv_en.tex and cv/cv_es.tex, while this one is just about the site itself.

sections.title: Second section
body: Write here too — sections[1].body. Add, remove or reorder paragraphs freely; the page rebuilds around whatever is in the file.
The square above shuffles through whatever images sit in docs/images-to-rotate/. Drop files in, run make html, and they join the rotation.
